title: Special Labour Conference Confirms Burnham as Party Leader
detail: A special Labour Party conference in central London formally confirmed Andy Burnham as party leader on 17 July 2026, a day after nominations closed with him as the sole candidate backed by more than 80% of Labour MPs. Addressing delegates, Burnham said the party was 'united' and pledged to 'take power back from Westminster and Whitehall and give it to the place where you live,' framing his leadership around devolution and a break from the Starmer era. His confirmation as leader cleared the final procedural step before he formally succeeded Keir Starmer as Prime Minister three days later.

media.caption: Andy Burnham addresses delegates after being confirmed as Labour leader at a special conference in London
